text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Earth has... entered.
Its 3rd lap, that is.

The way the Earth is spinning around... feels kind of similar
to how it was exactly one year ago... maybe.
—New Year's Day. Neo Universe entered the Senior Class, at last heading toward the "GATE" of trials.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Before we "slingshot"—let's do our "New Year's shrine visit."

With no way of knowing what the coming year held,
I decided to at least pray to the gods.

Neo Universe was offering her New Year's prayer...
or rather, sending some kind of telepathic thought toward the shrine.
choice_data_list: So what did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"To not disappear."
Because that... is the starting point.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Maintain existence at all costs.
In order to prevent the post-“GATE” history from being “reproduced.”

Those words lingered in my mind. In another universe,
after Neo Universe had disappeared...

What on earth had happened?
I wanted to know just for future reference.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: After the "GATE", in another universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy will end up "isolated."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Due to Neo Universe's
disappearance..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy made a dramatic leap in an instant.
Claiming the Autumn Senior Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: However, that was only the beginning of "ABSS."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In the very year Zenno Rob Roy made his mark... the "Great King" emerged from the generation right below him. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The following year, a "singularity" several times larger appeared.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
With two individuals rewriting the very roots of history—
a massive turning point approaches.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the alternate universe not only lacks
Neo Universe, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A universe that will swallow Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I had to "keep staying" there...
To interfere, and to keep it floating.
choice_data_list: Zenno Rob Roy is... getting swallowed up...

text_block_list.text:
The “Great King.” And the “Singularity.”
Just what kind of entities are they?
And—

It seems the massive waves kicked up by those two
will put Zenno Rob Roy at a considerable disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe is……"pathetic."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Left Zenno Rob Roy all "alone"...
"AGET"...
Things will sink into gloom. Even though it's New Year's, the mood is only growing bleaker. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Drinking... "Beverage"...

I wanted to give her a chance to catch her breath.
Speaking of drinks that boost your energy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Coffee"...
The black current coursing through this planet...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A place where I can "drink" is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Welcome... Neo Universe.
Please, have some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This blend is for you.

The shop I entered was a small establishment
where the mysterious Umamusume,
Manhattan Cafe, was helping out.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This... scent is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe becomes 'comforted.'
This 'coffee' is..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It is a specialty of the highest aroma.
Can you... see the sky?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative.
Our "solid" is...
Treated to an extraordinary cup, Neo Universe's mind seemed to find a moment of peace.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "An Incredible Tonic"... It looks as though drinking it would make you contain a "white hole"...

To make them feel super energized, over-the-counter stuff won't cut it.
An Umamusume who might have something amazing is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! Try drinking that!
A super premium batch just arrived!

This Umamusume is Agnes Tachyon. A mad scientist
of an Umamusume whose hobby is scientific research.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon... What are the "ingredients"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ingredients? In what sense? Never mind that, the reaction!
Look at the reaction! Come on, let's do it in one go!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Contact" unavailable. ..."Itadakimasu."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...How are the effects?
Come on! Show me the possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……“FLOR”。

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Furo... what?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“COSB,MIXEPENUP,SIFPELLIDE,
BABANSKYCREPEARD,ASSE……”。

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I have no idea what's going on!
But that's what makes it great! Pure chaos!

Stimulated somewhere deep within, endless fragments of factors
pour from her mouth.
Neo Universe seemed to experience a slight awakening.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Lovey-dovey amazake...
Neo Universe knows."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who can make that is—in this very room.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "I usually avoid it. That 'greasy,' deep-red amazake. But..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe must "forcibly"
exhilarate...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A gelatinous nebula... of carbohydrates...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The capacity keeps... doubling.
'4-seater', '8-seater',
'16-seater'......"

Neo Universe sampled a special amazake in her room.
Through its effects, she seemed to have unlocked a new door.
